messages:
maria: Hey team — finalizing the social cohort sequencing for the webinar on Apr 14. Need assets + routing plan. Quick asks: 3 X posts (pre, day-of, follow-up), 2 LinkedIn long-form posts, and 1 quote-card pack. @sam can you take the copy drafts by EOD? :spiral_calendar:

sam: Yep — I can push drafts. Do we want different voice for X vs LinkedIn (edgy vs. thoughtful)? Also will need the speaker quotes from product.

jordan: For inbound routing — can we send day-of replies to the webinar form into the SDR Slack channel + create a HubSpot lead source 'webinar-social'? @lee can you confirm the webhook?

lee: I can wire the webhook. Plan: social -> webhook -> intermediate API -> hubspot. Will need the short payload shape. Example payload we agreed: ```{
  "email": "",
  "campaign": "webinar_apr14_social",
  "source": "social",
  "post_id": ""
}```

brand-bot: Reminder: use approved brand color palette and logo variants from the asset kit: https://drive.google.com/xyz - thumbnails must be 1200x630 for LinkedIn.

maria: Good call. Sam — can you create 3 caption variations per post so we can A/B test? Keep one CTA as "Register" and one as "Watch Recording" for follow-up.

sam: Will do. Draft plan below, posting windows tentative: ```
- Apr 10 09:00 PT (pre: announce + registration)
- Apr 14 11:30 PT (day-of: reminder + live link)
- Apr 15 10:00 PT (follow-up: recording + signup)
```

jordan: For lead routing — suggested cadence for SDR follow-up: 1) immediate Slack + email nudge, 2) 24h drip, 3) 4-day check. I'll add sequences in HubSpot if @lee confirms webhooks.

lee: Confirmed — webhook done, I pushed the staging endpoint to the integration PR: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/412. Needs prod secret from ops before go-live.

maria: Excellent. Two more items: 1) Can we get paid X amplification for the Apr 10 post (small budget)? 2) Who's owning community replies for day-of?

jordan: I can own community replies for the first 6 hours after the day-of post. I’ll need a 3-line FAQ doc for quick answers.

sam: I'll make the FAQ snippets and tag you. Also uploading quote-cards to the asset folder in 1hr.

maria: Perfect. Final checklist for today: sam drafts (EOD), lee confirms prod secret + webhook, jordan sets HubSpot sequences, brand-bot assets linked. If all green tomorrow morning we schedule and request paid boost. :thumbsup:

lee: Noted — will ping ops for secret.

brand-bot: Asset upload complete: https://drive.google.com/abc - filenames: webinar_quote_pack_v1.zip

maria: Thanks — closing this thread once sam posts drafts. If anything blocks, ping me.
